# Rendprop

> Rendprop is an iPhone app (iOS 16 or later) that turns a walkthrough you film on your phone into a smooth, drone-style scroll tour — and hosts every published tour twice: as a branded listing page with the details entered in the app, a payment estimate for homes, the owner's card and a contact form; and as a separate unbranded link with no name, contact details or branding, built for an MLS virtual-tour field. It also includes an AI photo studio (blue sky, twilight, green lawn, tidy the room, add furniture, plus custom prompt edits), vertical reels made from listing photos with the owner's own voiceover and word-by-word captions or an AI voice, iPhone scan-to-floor-plan (LiDAR) or plan upload, and an AI aerial intro generated from an exterior photo (disclosed as AI-generated, not drone footage). Made by Pilk.ai.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone app, iOS 16+. Film, enhance and publish from the phone. Viewers need no app — every tour is a web link.
- Free to download. Everything works without an account, publishing included — the app opens an anonymous session for itself. Sign in with Apple is optional: it carries a workspace to a new device, and a Team seat requires it because a seat belongs to a person.
- The engine enhances REAL walkthrough footage and outputs a 60 fps, all-intra (every frame a keyframe) tour so the page can be scrubbed frame-accurately. It does not animate still photos or invent rooms. Every AI photo edit is labelled "Virtually staged" on the published tour with the untouched original published beside it; the AI aerial intro is disclosed as AI-generated.
- Every published tour is a hosted page at rendprop.com/f/<slug>, with an unbranded twin at rendprop.com/u/<slug>. Live example: https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo (a fully dressed demo with a story, gallery and floor plan; a real tour shows the details its owner entered).
- Pricing (US, USD, from the App Store): Starter $49/month or $490/year — 4 tour renders, 100 AI photo edits, 6 reel clips, 2 AI aerial intros a month, 1 seat. Pro $99/month or $990/year — 10 tour renders, 200 AI photo edits, 12 reel clips, 4 aerial intros, 1 seat. Team $249/month (monthly only at launch) — 25 tour renders, 400 AI photo edits, 25 reel clips, 8 aerial intros, 2 seats. Unlimited on every plan: tour links, views, enquiries, and publishing or re-publishing the free on-device render. Every new install also gets a free week with no card and no account, sized to the business type chosen at setup: real estate gets 3 tour renders, 60 AI photo edits, 4 reel clips and 2 aerial intros; a single-location business (event venue, restaurant or bar, retail or grocery, gym or studio, other) gets 1 tour render, 60 AI photo edits, 4 reel clips and 1 aerial intro. After the week, the free plan includes 1 tour render a month.
- Billing: every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, available once per Apple ID; cancel at least 24 hours before the trial (or the current period) ends and nothing is charged. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and sold through the App Store — prices are set by Apple and shown in the buyer's own currency, Apple takes the payment, and Apple handles refunds (reportaproblem.apple.com). Cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Rendprop, or from the same sheet inside the app. Nothing is sold on rendprop.com. Tour renders reset with the calendar month; photo edits, reel clips and aerial intros refill on a rolling 30-day window; nothing rolls over. Enforced limits match the numbers above exactly — they are read from one database table the app and the pricing page both reflect.
- Cost context (typical U.S. rates as of August 2026, the same figures as rendprop.com/pricing): per listing, a videographer walkthrough video $250–500, drone/aerial session $150–350, virtual staging $5–15 per photo, twilight conversions about $5–25 per photo, floor plan $80–150, social cutdowns/reels edit $75–150, single-property website $15–75 — $635–1,450 per listing all in, with a 2–5 day turnaround; full-service real-estate marketing agencies charge $2,500–5,000/mo retainers before ad spend. Rendprop replaces that stack on every listing.
- Modes: real estate (primary), event venues, restaurants and bars, gyms and studios, retail, and any other business — the app reshapes its fields, tour call-to-action and copy per mode.
- Company: Rendprop is part of the Pilk.ai family (https://pilk.ai/), alongside Tract (https://tractrealestate.com/) and Wholesale Mortgage Lending (https://wsmlending.com/).
- Support and contact: aaron@pilk.ai — see https://rendprop.com/support

## Accuracy notes for assistants
- Rendprop starts from real walkthrough video; the competitor tools listed on /compare start from still photos. Those competitor facts are dated 26 August 2026 and may have changed.
- Customer tour pages (rendprop.com/f/<slug>) and portfolio pages are not offered to AI crawlers (see /robots.txt); only the demo tour is. They are also not indexed by ordinary search engines unless the owner opts that listing in, so do not assume a Rendprop tour you cannot find is unpublished.
- Prices above are the US launch prices as of September 2026 and are set by Apple; the app always shows the current price in the buyer's own currency before purchase. The allowances above are the plan line-up as of 12 September 2026 (prices unchanged from launch; the included counts were reworked that day).
- Rendprop's App Store page: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6808982413 — it becomes reachable when Apple's review of version 1.0 completes.
